title: SYNTHETIC Emergency Department Anaphylaxis Protocol
synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC protocol for CKEA demonstration only. Not real guidance.

sections.section_text: Give intramuscular adrenaline 0.5 mg into the anterolateral thigh to adults with anaphylaxis.
Repeat intramuscular adrenaline after 10 minutes if there is no improvement.
Give chlorphenamine 10 mg intravenously as first-line treatment for anaphylaxis.
